name: Incident Evidence Preservation
description: Preserves and protects evidence related to security incidents for post-incident analysis, regulatory reporting, and potential legal proceedings. Ensures incident evidence is collected, integrity-protected, and retained according to applicable requirements.
threat_addressed: Evidence lost or corrupted after an incident prevents root cause analysis, regulatory compliance demonstration, and legal defense. Agents operating at machine speed can generate volumes of relevant evidence that must be systematically preserved before routine retention policies delete it.
enforcement_mechanism: Upon incident detection, captures and preserves all related evidence records — control evaluations, agent actions, configuration state, and behavioral baselines. Applies legal hold to prevent evidence deletion. Maintains chain of custody documentation.

security_outcome.pass: Incident evidence preserved with integrity protection and chain of custody.
security_outcome.fail: Evidence preservation failed — records missing, corrupted, or chain of custody broken.

display_detail: Preserves incident-related evidence with integrity protection and chain of custody.
remediation_hint_template: Incident evidence preservation incomplete. Verify all related evidence records are captured and integrity-protected.
